models.label: Elo
models.blurb: The live rating engine's pregame number. This is what the site publishes.

models.label: Hybrid
models.blurb: Elo blended with each team's frozen prior-season coefficient. Covers fewer seasons, because the earliest ones have no prior season to freeze.

models.label: Elo, same games
models.blurb: Elo again, over only the games the hybrid can predict. The like-for-like comparison: the two rows above are scored on different sets of games.

models.label: Always the home team
models.blurb: A constant equal to the observed home-win rate. Harder to beat than it sounds: home advantage is real signal, and this baseline is handed a rate measured on the very games it is scored against.

models.label: Coin flip
models.blurb: 0.5 for every game. The floor; anything that does not clear this is not a model.
